name: qkd_lnk-l1-COMMIT
purpose: Qwen TP8 two-die split (owner 10-14): KV/system-die link bridge qkd_lnk = ot_qkvd_split_kvlink, abutting the KV end qkd_d2d (N face = its r/t class faces) and driving the merged sequencer's ROM-side faces (S: x3, sd, kvd, ar, ds, pw) + the embedding gateway (E). New master (contract kvsys v1 slot 777.6 x 129.6, pin file results/arch/qwen_split_1014/kvsys_v1/pins/qkd_lnk.json). Every face input captured at a pin flop, every output launched from a flop. M5 leaf, recipe 2.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qkvd_split_kvlink #(.QB(8), .KB(8), .XS(40)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/split_20261014/ot_qkvd_split_kvlink.sv rtl/qwen_sys/split_20261014/ot_qwen_split_lvl.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_die_20261009/ot_qkvd_fifo.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: lnk_exact
bench.note: full 38-stage native TP8 decode step (32 FP32 Q + 4 KVN / 32 RES a layer) through ot_qkvd_rom_end + PHY model + ot_qkvd_kv_end SPL 1 + this bridge + the unchanged merged sequencer HEADS 1 / Q_FP32 1: Q->RES, posted K/V rows, 4 quadrant copies, token at H all bit-exact

bench.note: MUT 1 in the bridge: KVN tag bit 2 dropped (V rows posted as K): 73 errors
